notes.title: Demo Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Demo Patch 1.01 Update

- Fixed a bug where the relics "Squire's Shield" and "Beginner's Belt" would not grant a stat boost to the battle right after they are equipped.
- Rebalanced booster pack item rates
- Fixed a bug where controller keycaps were shown while using keyboard controls.
- Increased the appearance rate of a rare achievement event when you have cleared both demo paths.

notes.title: Fudgy Dice First Demo Release
notes.notes:
Fudgy Dice goes live with its first demo!

This demo features a small teaser of the full game, it includes 2 of the game's playable characters. Daisy and fudgy, with a small number of dice available in the full game. This gives you a chance to try the game before the full release. 

Multiplayer is included in this demo, so feel free to join a friend locally or through steam remote play together to experience fun for two!

I hope you all have fun with Fudgy Dice's first demo, future demos will include more of the game's features, but for now, I hope you all enjoy what I've got to share.

Any feedback on the game can be sent to contact.studio.ami@gmail.com

Have a great day everyone,

Ami
